from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollment(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment data extracted from a single university's Common Data Set document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university as reported in the document")
    asian_non_hispanic_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of Asian, non-Hispanic undergraduates")
    black_non_hispanic_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of Black, non-Hispanic undergraduates")
    hispanic_latino_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of Hispanic/Latino undergraduates")
    enrollment_scope: str | None = Field(description="Description of the enrollment column used (e.g., 'Total Undergraduates', 'Degree-seeking')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Academic year or reporting date string")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityEnrollment]
